Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (signaling, rolling stock, telecommunications, SCADA, AFC, and more), lead multidisciplinary technical coordination meetings, and manage interface activities throughout the project lifecycle. You’ll specifically take care of defining and maintaining Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and leading verification and validation activities, but also provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers. We’ll look to you for: Leading system integration and interface management activities between railway subsystems, including signaling, rolling stock, PSDs, telecommunications, and SCADA. Defining, preparing, reviewing, and validating Interface Control Documents (ICDs) to align technical, functional, and operational requirements. Preparing and reviewing Engineering Technical Notes (ETNs), interface specifications, and technical assessments to support design and integration activities. Managing signaling-related interfaces across design, implementation, testing, commissioning, and handover phases. Leading technical coordination meetings to resolve interface issues and integration risks. Reviewing system and subsystem designs to ensure compliance with project requirements, standards, and safety needs. Overseeing system integration, verification, and validation activities, including FAT, SAT, and integrated system testing. Analyzing operational scenarios to ensure seamless interaction between signaling and other railway systems. Supporting change management activities by assessing technical impacts on interfaces and integration. Providing technical leadership and guidance to junior engineers and stakeholders. All About You We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 8 years of experience in railway/metro projects, with significant experience in systems integration and signaling interfaces. Proven experience working with CBTC, ETCS, Interlocking, ATS, ATP, ATO, or other railway signaling systems. Strong background in ICD preparation, interface management, and multidisciplinary integration activities. Experience in requirements management, verification and validation, testing and commissioning, and system assurance processes. Familiarity with railway standards and practices (EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129, IEC standards, UIC, etc.). Proficient in English writing and speaking. Proficient in MS Office and AutoCAD (knowledge of project/document management tools is a plus). Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills. Strong communication and teamwork skills with the ability to mentor junior engineers. Good analytical and decision-making skills. Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also: Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines. Work with new security standards for rail signaling. Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues. Contribute to innovative projects that make a real impact on sustainable mobility. Utilize our dynamic and inclusive working environment. Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries. Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs. Progress towards leadership or technical specialization roles. Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognizes your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension). You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you! Important to note As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

review_candidates.description: At HKA, you’ll work with project owners, contractors and infrastructure investors across asset-heavy industries including Energy, Water, Transport, Resources and Data Centres, delivering complex programs reliably, on time and on budget. We support clients across the capital lifecycle, from setting major programs up for success, through commercial advisory and supply chain engagement, to delivery assurance during execution. You’ll contribute across this spectrum, combining strategic advice, capability building and hands-on support. What sets HKA apart is where we’ve come from. We’re globally recognised for claims and dispute resolution when projects don’t go to plan. That experience shapes how we work day to day, grounded in what actually happens on projects. You’ll be part of a team helping clients make better decisions, deliver more reliably and avoid costly missteps. At HKA, you’ll work alongside experienced practitioners on real project challenges, with early responsibility and tangible impact As Part Of The HKA Team You Can Expect A unique opportunity to influence a major infrastructure program through planning, governance, risk, and project controls. Exposure to complex, large-scale projects and senior decision-makers across the project lifecycle. The chance to contribute to a program that will deliver lasting benefits for the Sunshine Coast community. The Opportunity Our Project Management Office (PMO) team is preparing to support a landmark infrastructure program on the Sunshine Coast, creating a rare opportunity for experienced project controls and PMO professionals to join a major program in its formative stages. This high-profile, multi-disciplinary infrastructure program will help shape the future of one of Australia's fastest-growing regions. We're seeking experienced professionals who thrive in complex project environments and can provide the insights, governance, and controls that underpin successful project delivery. We're currently seeking talented professionals across several PMO disciplines, including: Cost Managers Planners and Schedulers Risk Managers Governance, Assurance & Reporting Managers Project Controls Managers Change Control Managers Document Controllers As part of the PMO team, you'll play a critical role in providing the forecasting, planning, risk management, reporting, and governance frameworks that enable effective decision-making across the program. Working closely with project leadership, delivery teams, and key stakeholders, you'll help drive performance, manage complexity, and support successful project outcomes. Joining the program at this stage offers a unique opportunity to influence how major projects are planned, governed, and delivered. You'll work alongside industry-leading professionals on a program of significant scale and complexity while contributing to an enduring legacy for the Sunshine Coast. Whether you're looking to apply your expertise on a career-defining infrastructure program or seeking an opportunity to make a strategic impact within a high-performing PMO environment, this is a rare chance to be part of something significant. Skills And Experience To be successful in this opportunity, you will bring a combination of project controls expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence outcomes within complex infrastructure environments. Ideally, You Will Possess The Following Demonstrated experience (typically 10+ years) within project controls, PMO, or project delivery functions on major infrastructure, transport, civil, utilities, or capital works programs. Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across project teams, clients, delivery partners, and executive stakeholders. Proven experience working within complex, multidisciplinary project environments, collaborating across multiple workstreams, interfaces, and delivery functions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and provide meaningful insights to senior stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with experience translating project data into actionable recommendations and business outcomes. Experience managing competing priorities within large-scale, fast-paced project environments while maintaining a focus on delivery objectives. A continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to strengthening governance, controls, reporting, and best-practice project delivery frameworks. Advanced proficiency in project controls, reporting, forecasting, risk management, scheduling, governance, or cost management disciplines relevant to your area of expertise. Flexibility and willingness to travel across the Sunshine Coast region as required to support project delivery. Desirable Experience Candidates with any of the following experience will be highly regarded: Experience working within major infrastructure, transport, roads, rail, utilities, or capital works programs. Previous involvement in client-side, contractor, consultancy, alliance, or integrated delivery environments. Knowledge of alliance contracting principles and collaborative project delivery models. Experience supporting program governance, assurance, reporting, portfolio management, or project controls functions within complex project environments. Experience working with local government, state government, or other major infrastructure stakeholders. Involvement in establishing or enhancing PMO frameworks, project controls systems, reporting processes, or governance structures on large-scale programs. Our priority is to provide an inclusive and collaborative culture aimed at providing the best opportunities for our people to thrive and develop in their chosen career path. We operate a flexible working pattern both in terms of hours and location and are happy with flexible remote working. Our Global Recruitment team is committed to providing an authentic candidate experience for all those who take the time to apply to HKA. We are committed to providing an efficient and insightful recruitment process giving candidates a true reflection of life at HKA. All HKA employment decisions are firstly made on merit and shall be made without regard to age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, marriage, and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation, or any other basis in compliance with local legislation. We will never ask for sensitive personal information during the job application process. If you have any doubts, we recommend you visit our website to verify job listings before applying. If you would like more confirmation, please feel free to email us at enquiries@hka.com to check the authenticity of a job posting. review_candidates.description: Job Description Background: UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action, and peace and security. Under the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2026–2030 and the UN Women Armenia Biannual Work Plan (2026–2027), UN Women supports the Government of Armenia and national partners in advancing gender equality and women's empowerment through strengthening gender-responsive governance, promoting women's leadership and participation in decision-making, preventing and responding to violence against women and girls, advancing the Women, Peace and Security agenda, expanding women's economic empowerment, and transforming discriminatory social norms and gender stereotypes. Working in partnership with government institutions, civil society organizations, women's rights organizations, academia, the private sector, development partners and the United Nations system, UN Women implements a diverse portfolio of programmes and initiatives aimed at strengthening institutional capacities, promoting gender-responsive policies and services, supporting women's leadership and participation, advancing gender-responsive governance, and fostering inclusive and equitable social and economic development. These interventions are implemented through national and regional partnerships and contribute to Armenia's international commitments on gender equality, human rights, sustainable development, and peace and security. Reporting to the Programme Analyst, Gender Equality in Yerevan, Armenia, under the overall guidance of the Programme Specialist based in Armenia, the Programme Assistant provides programme, administrative and operational support for the effective implementation of UN Women's programme portfolio in Armenia. The incumbent supports programme planning and implementation, financial and administrative processes, monitoring and reporting, partner coordination, procurement, logistics, knowledge management and communications, ensuring compliance with UN Women policies, procedures and donor requirements. Working closely with programme teams in Armenia and operations teams in Armenia and Georgia, the Regional Office for Europe and Central Asia, government counterparts, civil society organizations, development partners and other stakeholders, the Project Assistant contributes to the efficient delivery of programme activities, facilitates coordination across multiple programme portfolios, and supports the effective implementation of UN Women's strategic priorities in Armenia. Assist in tracking routine programme activities and maintaining implementation records. Support the collection and compilation of information required for programme reporting and audits. Assist in preparing payment requests for consultants and vendors. Maintain records of expenditures and supporting documentation. Support the preparation of routine financial information and budget tracking spreadsheets. Assist with the operational and financial closure of projects by organizing required documentation. Prepare meeting invitations, attendance lists, agendas, and meeting materials. Arrange travel for programme personnel, including travel requests, hotel bookings, visa documentation, and travel claims. Assist in preparing briefing materials, presentations, and information packages. Maintain inventories of office supplies and programme materials, as required. Support resource mobilization and partnership activities Assist in maintaining records of donor contributions, agreements, and project documentation. review_candidates.description: Role Overview: The Performance Designer & Video Editor plays a crucial role in driving growth and conversion across all paid social touchpoints, primarily focusing on channels such as Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Combining strong creative instinct with execution, this role turns strategic insights into high-converting statics, dynamic motion graphics, and engaging UGC edits that capture attention and compel action. This position is designed for an AI-first creator who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced performance marketing environment. Rather than viewing AI as an optional add-on, the ideal candidate uses generative tools as a primary engine to multiply output speed, build scalable design systems, accelerate creative testing, and reliably produce high-performing ad variations at scale. Essential Job requirements Performance Design & Video Portfolio: Proven experience in digital graphic design and short-form video editing, backed by a strong portfolio of live paid social ads (statics, motion graphics, and UGC). Mobile-First Ad Mechanics: Deep understanding of paid social frameworks, including scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced retention pacing, native visual triggers, dynamic captions, and platform safe zones. Tool Stack Mastery: Design capability in Figma or Canva, paired with proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or CapCut Pro). Generative AI Workflows: Practical experience using AI production tools (such as ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Runway, HeyGen, or Captions) to accelerate ideation and editing. High-Volume UGC Iteration: Hands-on experience editing raw creator footage into polished ad concepts and rapidly building multiple hook/layout variations from a single brief. Performance Collaboration: Agile, collaborative mindset - able to take data-driven feedback from Creative Strategists and Performance Marketers to quickly iterate on creatives and generate variations. Desirable Performance Marketing Context: Experience working directly within or alongside growth/performance marketing teams or agency ad operations. Data Fluency: Practical understanding of key performance metrics (such as Click-Through Rate, Hook Rate, Hold Rate) and how visual decisions directly influence ad outcomes. D2C or Regulated Space: Previous experience with Direct-to-Consumer (D2C), health tech, or healthcare brands. Education & Qualifications: Degree in Graphic Design, Motion Design, Digital Media, or equivalent practical experience demonstrating strong creative output. Job Responsibilities Design & Asset Production Direct-Response Statics: Design high-converting, mobile-first static ad graphics and layout variations. Motion Design: Create dynamic motion graphics, kinetic typography, 2D animations, and native UI/product demos. Short-Form Video & UGC: Cut raw creator footage into engaging, fast-paced videos with native captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts. Platform Optimization: Ensure all deliverables strictly adhere to platform safe zones, mobile aspect ratios, and channel best practices. Rapid Creative Iteration Hook & Angle Testing: Partner closely with the Creative Strategist to brainstorm and execute new visual hooks, copy angles, and graphic variations to combat creative fatigue and scale campaign spend. Data-Driven Edits: Rapidly spin out variations of winning concepts based on performance data. AI-Powered Workflows & Systems Generative Production: Actively integrate generative AI tools (e.g., for voiceover synthesis, script-to-video editing, image generation, and automated captioning) to multiply weekly creative output. AI Asset Management: Build and maintain a library of assets (AI-tagged / organized), motion presets, and modular templates for rapid variant creation. Workflow Innovation: Continuously test and evaluate new AI tools, plugins, and generative workflows to reduce turnaround times and lower production overhead. Job Benefits The opportunity to drive meaningful, life-changing impact through your work. A high-growth environment with strong development opportunities. Flexible working options – including remote working. Personal learning budget and development plans. A home working allowance to create your ideal workspace. Competitive salary (shared in the first screening call) and benefits

review_candidates.title: Palestine and Gulf Strategic Partnerships Senior Advisor
review_candidates.description: Type: Three-year fixed term contract, with the potential to become permanent after this period. Full time (35 hours per week). Part-time hours may also be considered if above 0.7 FTE. Location: This home-based role can be worked from flexible location options in the South West Asia and North Africa region. Salary: Salaries and benefits will vary by country, depending on the successful candidate's location. We offer competitive, market-aligned renumeration, which can be adjusted in exceptional cases depending on a candidate's experience, skills, and potential. The salary for this role is likely to be in the region of US $125,000 to 150,000 p.a. About You We are looking for a highly connected, strategic and entrepreneurial relationship-builder with a strong understanding of philanthropy, partnerships and influence across Palestine and the Gulf region. Passionate about MAP's mission and committed to supporting the health and dignity of Palestinians, you will bring credibility, insight and the ability to build meaningful relationships that create long-term value for the organisation. You will have a strong knowledge of the philanthropic, corporate and institutional funding landscape across Palestine and the Gulf States, alongside experience of developing partnerships with major donors, foundations, corporates, family offices, institutional funders or other senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating at a senior level, representing organisations externally and opening doors to new opportunities. Existing networks and relationships in the region will be a significant advantage. An excellent communicator and relationship manager, you can engage and inspire a wide range of audiences in culturally appropriate ways. You are equally comfortable developing high-level strategies, analysing opportunities and risks, and translating organisational priorities into compelling partnership propositions. Knowledge of Palestinian and Gulf cultures, philanthropic traditions and Islamic giving, including Zakat, will help you succeed in this role. You are a self-starter who thrives working independently across multiple priorities, while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues based in different locations. Most importantly, you share MAP's commitment to equality, diversity, safeguarding and anti-discriminatory practice, and are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to the rights and dignity of Palestinians. Frequent travel within the region and occasional travel to the UK will be required. About MAP MAP's vision is a future in which all Palestinians can access an effective, sustainable and locally led system of healthcare and the full realisation of their rights to health and dignity. We work alongside Palestinian communities and trusted local partners to respond to immediate humanitarian needs while strengthening health systems for the long term. We also amplify Palestinian voices and advocate for an end to the barriers to health and dignity caused by occupation, displacement, conflict and discrimination. In recent years, MAP has experienced a period of unprecedented growth, enabling us to expand both our humanitarian response and our long-term development work. As we continue to deliver our ambitious organisational strategy through to 2028, we are committed to sustaining this growth, deepening our impact and strengthening the partnerships that make our work possible. Partnerships and philanthropy play a critical role in achieving this ambition. We are seeking new ways to engage supporters, organisations and institutions that share our commitment to Palestinian health, dignity and rights, ensuring they can play a meaningful role in delivering lasting change. About the Role This is an exciting new role at a pivotal moment for MAP. This role will help shape MAP's future engagement across Palestine and the Gulf region, identifying new opportunities for income growth, strategic partnerships and organisational influence. Working closely with colleagues across fundraising, programmes, communications and advocacy, you will help establish MAP as a trusted and credible partner within key markets and networks. As MAP's senior fundraising and partnerships representative in the region, you will lead market scoping and relationship development activity, building connections with philanthropists, family offices, charitable foundations, corporate partners, institutional funders, academic institutions and other influential stakeholders. You will use your knowledge, networks and judgement to identify the most promising opportunities, build a pipeline of strategic relationships and make recommendations about MAP's future investment and approach in the region. This is a unique opportunity for a well-connected and ambitious professional who combines strategic thinking with exceptional relationship-building skills. If you are passionate about supporting Palestinians and excited by the challenge of building new partnerships and unlocking opportunities for growth and impact, we would love to hear from you Key Responsibilities: 1. Strategy, Market Scoping and Insight - Lead an initial scoping initiative to map the fundraising landscape in Palestine and the Gulf region, identifying high value opportunities, emerging trends, and region-specific fundraising approaches. 2. Relationship Development and Representation - Represent MAP at a senior level with Palestine and Gulf stakeholders, positioning the organisation as a trusted, expert and credible partner. 3. Proposal Development and Reporting - Collaborate with Philanthropy, Programmes and Communications teams to produce compelling, culturally attuned proposals, concept notes and presentations for Palestine and Gulf prospects. For more detail please see the full role profile. RECRUITMENT PROCESS First interviews will take place on Microsoft Teams in the week commencing Monday 2nd November. If you have any questions, or reasonable adjustment requests at any point in the application and recruitment process, please contact recruitment@map-uk.org. How to Apply Please submit your CV and Cover Letter no more than 1,000 words outlining your suitability for the role and your motivation for working with MAP, before the deadline of 23:59 GMT on Thursday 22nd October 2026 via our Careers page. N.B Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Candidates may be contacted for an initial informal conversation ahead of formal interviews in November. Equal opportunities MAP aims to be an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable. Background checks As an organisation MAP is committed to the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable adults. MAP will conduct appropriate background and references checks. Disclaimer **MAP reserves the right to close this advert before the confirmed closing date when we are in receipt of sufficient applications. **We would therefore advise interested applicants to apply as early as possible. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive, we are unable to respond to every application. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of the deadline, then you have not been successful in shortlisting

review_candidates.title: METAL Coordinator
review_candidates.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. The IRC Yemen began its programs in October 2012. Since establishing its presence in the South of Yemen, in the Red Sea Coastal city of Aden, the organization has grown from just an implementing small project to handling large scale emergency and relief operations. Following the war which broke out in Yemen in March of 2015 and the humanitarian disaster, which was crafted by the same, IRC launched one an emergency response program in the southern governorates of Aden, Lahj, Abyan, Shabwah and Al Dhale, and expanded later in Sana’a and Hodeidah in the North. Currently IRC Yemen is operating in eight governorates in the south and north of Yemen through direct programming and through local partnerships, in Health, WASH, Nutrition, Economic Recovery Development, Education, Child Protection, Gender and Women Protection and Empowerment. The International Rescue Committee (IRC) have been working in the Middle East, North Africa and Ukraine (MENAU) for more than forty years. Today, the IRC has more than 2,200 staff working across the region, including in Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Libya, Syria, Ukraine and Yemen to support those affected by some of the world’s most complex and protracted humanitarian crises. Scope Of Work The METAL Coordinator will provide national leadership and management oversight to ensure that the Yemen country program develops and achieves METAL commitments. The METAL Coordinator will lead a dynamic department comprised of two teams: Monitoring & Evaluation and Client Responsiveness & Accountability. Job Summary This position reports to the Deputy Director of Programs and is responsible for ensuring that data and learning are applied towards continuous improvements in program quality and evidence-based program design and make every effort to ensure data visualization products are used by project teams and the country SMT. The METAL Coordinator is responsible for ensuring that monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and data management systems are in place, sufficiently resourced, and successfully implemented from collection to visualization. The Coordinator will ensure that METAL principles are integrated into every step of the project cycle. In support of these goals, this position provides technical assistance, facilitates capacity sharing, and ensures ongoing mentoring and training in METAL concepts for IRC and partner staff. Working Relations METAL Coordinator is supported technically by the Regional Measurement Advisor (RMA) and the Regional Technology Coordinator (RTC) This position is based in Aden with occasional travel to program sites across Yemen. Main Responsibilities Technical Oversight Provide technical leadership to ensure strong data systems and processes throughout the project cycle, from design and implementation to close-out and learning. Use learning and evidence from internal and external sources to inform proposal design and theories of change. Develop and operationalize logical frameworks, METAL plans, data collection tools, processes for data management, client feedback approaches, quality checks and audits, and data visualization. Provide METAL technical assistance to program teams during the design and inception stages, including support with logframes, indicator selection and measurement methodologies, and the development of data collection plans and tools. Develop a METAL budget and staffing structure for all projects that is responsive to planned activities and data requirements. Ensure the effective set-up and use of data platforms to ensure effective data collection, management and presentation including METAL Maturity Assessments. Using the organizational PID approach, produce high-quality data, analysis, reports, presentations, and dashboards of key findings that foster learning and decision-making. Present findings in project cycle meetings and strategic management team meetings as required and foster utilization. Provide technical leadership for the design, method, and conduct of surveys such as baseline and endline, and the commission of evaluations and surveys as required in coordination with program coordinators, technical advisors, and external partners. Lead the expansion of Commcare for data collection and PowerBI dashboards to enhance the timeliness and quality of data collection, analysis, and visualization. Provide technical leadership to external accountability commitments through the implementation of sound accountability, client feedback, and response mechanisms. Strengthen client feedback and response mechanisms based on regional standards and expectations using CR Maturity Criteria Assessments. Strategic Leadership Establish and drive common strategies and approaches to METAL that reflect and contextualize Strategy 100 and the Country Strategic Action Plan. Guided by the METAL Handbook, lead all aspects of METAL functions across multiple sectors and multiple geographical areas. Champion an organizational culture where data is routinely used for evidence-based decision making and program adaptation. Shape and implement METAL systems and approaches that meet IRC standards and practices, are responsive to program needs, and enable accountability to clients, partners, and donors. Develop, coordinate and strengthen capacity-sharing partnerships with METAL counterparts of partner agencies, local organizations, and government as required. Reinforce integration of cross-sectoral priorities in METAL, including gender, protection, safeguarding, disaster risk reduction, Diversity-Equality-Inclusion and Do No Harm. Staff Management and Development Establish an efficient and responsive staffing structure for the METAL department which considers a balanced workload and optimal ways of working to support a large multi-sector program. Supervise the METAL team across multiple sectors and geographical areas. Set clear performance objectives, schedule regular check-in meetings, manage staff work plans, conduct regular performance reviews, champion a positive working environment for professional development, and foster an inclusive and respectful team climate. Coach, train, supervise, and mentor METAL department staff. Promote the growth and development of the team. Assess proficiencies and develop and lead a targeted learning and training strategy. Develop and implement remote management capacity building approaches to build the strengths of the METAL team. Partnership Program Delivery Ensure that Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) systems integrate partnership principles and reflect partner contributions. Participate in Partnership Cycle Management (PCM), including joint monitoring visits, reflection sessions, and after-action reviews with partners. Support partners in developing and implementing MEAL plans, ensuring alignment with project objectives and donor requirements. Ensure timely and accurate data collection, analysis, and reporting from partners, providing feedback to strengthen data quality. Program Support & Capacity Sharing Provide technical support and training to partners on MEAL tools, methodologies, and accountability mechanisms. Facilitate learning and knowledge-sharing sessions between IRC and partners to promote adaptive management and continuous improvement. Support partners in establishing feedback and complaint mechanisms that are safe, accessible, and responsive to communities. Leadership & Team Management Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and accountability within IRC and partner teams. Ensure MEAL staff understand and apply IRC’s partnership principles and approaches in all interactions with partners. Other Promote and actively participate in initiatives and efforts to build team engagement, inclusion, and cohesion in IRC Yemen Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue, and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies. Educate/raise awareness among the community and clients about the existing feedback mechanisms and response processes Other relevant duties as assigned by supervisor to further IRC METAL objectives. REQUIREMENTS: (Qualifications, Skills and Abilities): A. Education:A university degree in a relevant subject area (statistics, data management, social sciences, public health, economic development, or a related field). A technical degree together with additional relevant work experience may substitute for education. B. Experience:A minimum of 5 years of work experience within MEAL-related functions, including experience leading data collection and analysis for multi-sector and multi-donor funded humanitarian programs. C. Skills and Abilities: Excellent understanding of a range of quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis methods required. Demonstrated ability to develop functional and user-friendly systems to utilize routine and survey data in program quality improvement and evidence-based decision-making. A strong understanding of accountability mechanisms and proven ability to build responsive client feedback systems is a distinct advantage. Leadership experience and demonstrated ability to transfer knowledge to diverse audiences through training and mentoring. Proficiency and experience with mobile data collection software such as Kobo, CommCare, and ODK Collect is essential, as well as proficiency with Microsoft Excel, SPSS, STATA, or other similar software. Knowledge of Tableau, PowerBI, or GIS software are additional assets. Excellent verbal and written data presentation and reporting skills. Able to interpret data and communicate complex analysis to external audiences in a concise and easy to understand manner. Excellent spoken and written English. Ability to communicate in Arabic is an advantage. D. Proficiencies: Strong cross-cultural communication skills and comfortable working as part of a diverse team. Sensitive to interpersonal differences and a range of viewpoints. Excellent advance planning and organizational skills. Able to effectively prioritize and follow multiple activities and deadlines simultaneously. Analytical, strategic, and eager to develop solutions to complex challenges. Flexible and innovative. Able to adapt plans and pivot approaches in response to changes in context. Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Professional Standards: The IRC and IRC workers must adhere to the values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. These are Integrity, Service, and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Beneficiary Protection from Exploitation and Abuse, Child Safeguarding, Anti Workplace Harassment, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation. IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. IRC strives to build a diverse and inclusive team at all levels who as individuals, and as a group, embody our culture statement creating a working environment characterized by critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity for us to achieve our aspirations as a team and deliver the best possible services to our clients. Gender Equality: IRC is committed to narrowing the gender gap in leadership positions. We offer benefits that provide an enabling environment for women to participate in our workforce including parental leave, gender-sensitive security protocols and other supportive benefits and allowances. Commitment to Client Responsiveness: By committing to Client-Centered Programming, at the IRC Yemen, we place the people we serve - our clients - at the center of our programming and services. The IRC Yemen Staff have an important role to play in supporting the implementation of client-responsive programming through raising awareness among the community and clients about the existing feedback mechanisms and how to use them including the response processes, access, and eligibility to services, and contribute to building an institutional culture that prompts staff to listen to clients. Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.
